lessons.lesson: Add numbers up to 4 digits without regrouping

records.learning_outcome: be able to understand the concepts covered clearly, The parent will not appreciate as this is what they can teach at home,especially Indian parent as it is totally indian style, include games and small word problems, and an alternate way to add ,as in most USA books ,they relate addition with not only one way but two ways
records.enough_examples: Its good that only one way is being learnt, but in USA they have multiple ways of thinking about addition ,
records.learnings_engagement: need more fun/engagement, The learning is boring old school style, no game, no activity, no concept of addition ,only process,
records.learnings_language: explains concepts well without the use of big/difficult words or being text heavy, In one of the options there was use of place value ,we can frame it using place names,
records.learning_suggestions: As per my experience if children learn addition with this method they know process based addition, they do not want to put brains on any other way. Like some children add from hundreds ,then tens and then ones , its without regroupung then why start at ones place, we can ask ,how many total hundreds ,how many tens and how many ones in reverse order too, its about thinking and observing,in most usa books ,I have seen they ask to solve the same question using 2 or three different ways.In India also our books had all methods  ,but children generally  pick up only starting at ones . If you want only one process in the learning sheet ,at least make a provision for the teacher to ask a question , can you solve this question in another way, like adding place value of hundreds , then tens then ones.
records.practice_quality: have the right mix of easy and difficult, providing students with a productive struggle, not engaging, Should be more engaging and fun filled activity one
records.practice_suggestions: Include some games ,where child adds then moves ahead, five questions in a game form
records.rating_label: 4 - Very Good: Learning mostly clear, sufficient practice supports learning, students will be mostly engaged
records.overall_suggestions: Its too boring ,there should be colors, characters to make the page attractive, games where student has fun with learning,there should  be guidance for teachers to ask what child knows about addition ,what alternative ways they have learnt earlier, so they can connect the concept.

They dont even try to learn another way ,mental math they put under mental math , they try only when asked to do mentally, it should come naturally to add in different ways.I dont want it to be included in this sheet but teacher should cue the student if he knows it and can apply, or she can orient the child think in that direction
